name: Rare Michigan | Party Girl
description: Party Girl: This Party Girl is a sativa dominant strain with lemon pepper terps that will grip an entire room and demand your full attention. Her flowers are the rock-hard buds you’ve come to expect from RMG with a thick coat of glistening crystals. Party Girl rocks your mind and body evenly as a true party animal should. Your ‘go-to gal’ when it’s time to party!
